launch: Run the CLI from the attested app image using a new temporary home.
cleanup: The probes remove the temporary home and the runner removes the container.

doctor.drive: Run openclaw --version in an isolated home.
doctor.observe: The CLI version matches package.json in the attested image.
doctor.gotchas: Startup alone does not verify the report.

features.reach: Ask the CLI to check the skills in the local workspace.
features.drive: Run skills check --json in a disposable home with modern and legacy example skills.
features.observe: The JSON identifies the legacy skill and excludes the modern skill from the warning. Both fixture files are unchanged.
features.gotchas: Synthetic skills contain metadata only. There are no install requests or external services.
